policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

Minneapolis Public Housing Authority (MPHA): Housing Choice Voucher payment standards 2027 (Metro-wide FMR, 90-100% (2BR 90%, 3BR 92%, 4BR 96%); effective 2027-01-01). MPHA set standards BELOW HUD FMR (2027 FMR 2BR $1,734) because of federal funding shortfall; 3BR+ frozen.

source_of_income.meaning: protected = a landlord may not refuse a tenant because rent is paid with a voucher; false = no protection or state preemption, so accepting vouchers is voluntary

reasons: City permit/licence required: Yes: licence for stays of 30 days or fewer. Renting a spare room while the host stays home is exempt.
Caps/density: 1 non-homestead STR licence per owner; in buildings of 20+ units at most 10% may be STRs (not applied to condo buildings).
Pending: Zoning amendments under review: Housing with 1-3 Units (council vote scheduled Dec 3, 2026) and Safe Outdoor Parking (vehicle-sleeping sites). No pending STR licence change found.

permit.value: Yes: licence for stays of 30 days or fewer. Renting a spare room while the host stays home is exempt.

primary_residence.value: No, but an owner (LLCs included) may hold only one STR licence besides their home; non-homestead units must submit management and floor plans.

zones.value: Short-term rental units count as dwelling units under zoning and are licensed under Ch. 351, so they go wherever dwellings are allowed. Hotels and hostels (5-20 rooms) are a separate lodging use, limited to certain districts.

caps.value: 1 non-homestead STR licence per owner; in buildings of 20+ units at most 10% may be STRs (not applied to condo buildings).

taxes.value: Combined sales tax 9.025% (6.875% state plus local) plus 3% Minneapolis entertainment tax on all short-term lodging; Minneapolis lodging tax only for 50+ room establishments. Facilitating platforms collect.

listing_id.value: Yes, licence ID must be on the platform listing; licence number serves as registration number, exempt rooms state the exemption.

pending.value: Zoning amendments under review: Housing with 1-3 Units (council vote scheduled Dec 3, 2026) and Safe Outdoor Parking (vehicle-sleeping sites). No pending STR licence change found.

state_preemption.value: No state preemption of STR rules found; cities license STRs (Minneapolis licence, Saint Paul Ch. 379). State and local taxes apply and facilitating platforms collect.

pools.method: NAIP/open orthophoto water pixels (NDWI>0.10, blue>red, not dark, not roof/tree via LiDAR+footprints) -> compact 12-150 m2 sites fixed across snapshots -> per-snapshot state from grey-world-balanced colour + NDWI/NDVI, relative to the context window's clean pools; see usa/research/pools_method.md

thermal.source: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (ST_B10), USGS, via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC 'landsat-c2-l2'
thermal.clear_rule: QA_PIXEL fill/dilated-cloud/cirrus/cloud/shadow all clear on every block pixel, >=80% clear within 2 km, Tier 1 only, ST_QA uncertainty <= 6 K
thermal.overpass_local: ~10:30-11:00 local solar time (Landsat); afternoon peak LST is higher
thermal.urban_heat_note: On the hottest clear summer pass (2025-07-15) the block averaged 42.2 C, 0.9 C cooler than the median of clear pixels within 2 km (43.1 C); across all 50 clear passes the block is on average -0.2 C vs its 2 km surroundings. Surface (skin) temperature, not air temperature.
thermal.house_pixel_note: 30 m pixel covers several houses/yard; not a roof-only reading
thermal.hot_roof_rule: houses whose mean (pixel - block median) across all clear scenes is in the block's top decile and > 0; houses sharing one 30 m pixel share the flag

sun_context.note: h.sun is modelled from LiDAR; measured LST is a 30 m mixed pixel (roof+yard+trees). Use together only as context.
